study_title: Shotgun metagenomic sequencing of anoxic and reoxygenated marine sediments from Paddehavet (Norway)
study_description: Artificial oxygenation can be used to restore oxygen-depleted coastal basins, yet key microbial responses and oxygen-consumption pathways remain poorly understood. The aim of this study was to investigate the initial consumption of oxygen and sulfides in Paddehavet during a reoxygenation experiment. Shotgun metagenomic sequencing was performed both on samples from a laboratory based oxygenation experiment, on samples from Paddehavet prior to oxygenation and after 4 months of oxygenation. Paddehavet is located in the Oslofjord (Norway). The project was carried out in collaboration with The Norwegian Institute for Water Research (NIVA) and funded by Hafslund.
